meta.title: Bids cannot be unlocked before the submission window closes
gaps: Directly verify that the bid values remain hidden after attempting to unlock bids
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly verify that the bid values remain hidden after attempting to unlock bids

Open the event Settings menu containing Unlock Bids.
Assert that Unlock Bids is not offered before the submission deadline, proving the action cannot be started in this state.
